campaign: age-gated terminal-flare for long GNSS outage descent
evidence_level: L2 (real firmware + 6DOF plant + sensor models, SIL only)
purpose: Reduce hard touchdown after long GNSS outage without changing the normal 20 s outage behavior. Flare only when outage age >20 s and altitude <8 m, using a 0.5 s baro-altitude slope for vertical velocity and a 0.5 m/s target descent rate.
scenario: 30 m settled, 1 m/s target ramp, 1 m/s2 wind, 6 directions x 10 seeds; 20 s outage 43-63 s and 60 s outage 43-103 s; run 113/133 s

20s_flare.note: identical to baseline; age gate never reached before GNSS recovery

caveats: The flare is gated on g_gnss_outage_age_s >20 s; the 20 s outage recovers before the gate, so there is no 20 s regression.
The 60 s maximum touchdown remains 4.03 m/s; the flare reduces the median/p95 but is not a soft-landing guarantee.
Landing drift increases ~20% median / ~41% p95 because the last 8 m take longer.
SIL plant has no landing gear/impact model; touchdown speeds are kinematic.
Opt-in macro, default off; not real aircraft.
